snippet.title: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered Reveal Trailer | Nightdive Studios
snippet.description:
The Keepers call to you now… will you answer them? No longer a secret, Thief: The Dark Project Remastered returns!

Immerse yourself in the darkness once again, now with enhancements to graphic textures, models, animations, quality of life improvements, and more. 

Coming to PlayStation 4|5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Play Anywhere, Nintendo Switch 1 & 2, Steam, Epic Games Store and GOG this Winter!
===========================
Wishlist now:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4200960/Thief_The_Dark_Project_Remastered
GOG: https://www.gog.com/en/game/thief_the_dark_project_remastered
EGS: https://store.epicgames.com/p/thief-the-dark-project-remastered-a4b0a3
Sony: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10019830
Microsoft: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/thief-the-dark-project-remastered/9P858BX7N341
